title: ReproduceResult
description: What a reproduce Smith writes to /work/out/result.json. The engine checks it (ReadResultDelegate) before its own rules; the Smith checks it with check-result reproduce. Strict types where the engine branches, any non-empty JSON where it only passes content on.

outcome.description: Branched on by the engine and the BPMN.

testable.description: Branched on: whether the fix needs a regression test.

filesDropped.description: Set by the engine, not the Smith: why /work/out/repro was not carried to the fix and verify runs (larger than its cap).

content.description: Passed on to a brief or a GitHub comment, never branched on: any non-empty JSON. A string is shown as itself; an object or array as a fenced JSON block.
